meta.name: provider-builder
meta.description: Use when a teammate wants to add a new vendor to YALC for an existing capability without shipping a release. Triggers include "add a new provider for X", "wire up [vendor] to YALC", "build an adapter for [vendor]", "I want to use [vendor] for [capability]", "add Apollo for icp-company-search", or any variant indicating they want to author a declarative YAML manifest under `~/.gtm-os/adapters/`. Converts a vendor name + capability id + docs URL into a registered, smoke-tested manifest in roughly five minutes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的供应商名称、能力 ID 和文档 URL，编写一个声明式 YAML 适配器文件，进行冒烟测试，通过后自动注册到本地适配器目录中。整个过程约 5 分钟，不会读取或打印任何 API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你说“为 X 添加一个新供应商”、“把 [供应商] 接入 YALC”、“为 [供应商] 构建适配器”等，或任何表明你想在 ~/.gtm-os/adapters/ 下创建声明式 YAML 时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude converts a vendor name, capability ID, and docs URL into a declarative YAML adapter manifest, smoke-tests it against the live vendor, and registers it under ~/.gtm-os/adapters/. The process takes about five minutes and never reads or prints API keys.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add a new provider for X", "wire up [vendor] to YALC", "build an adapter for [vendor]", or any variant indicating you want to author a declarative YAML manifest under ~/.gtm-os/adapters/.
